provenance.coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; unchanged 8192x3616 decoded official PNG pixels; inclusive bounds. Not registered to EU4 geometry.
provenance.provinceIdEncoding: RGB PNG id = R + 256*G; B=0. ID zero reserved. IDs are rank+1 in sorted RGB union, not official province numbers.
provenance.coverage: Only provinces explicitly listed in map_data/state_regions/anb_cannor.txt receive a displayed political owner. This source scope includes Eastern Cannor/Deepwoods; it is broader than western Cannor.
provenance.outsideCoverage: owner=null and coverage=false means unresearched in this atlas, not unowned.
provenance.conflictPolicy: All different-owner assignments are retained in validation; displayed owner is null on any conflict. No guessed last-wins policy.
provenance.flags: Four flags composed from pinned V3 source recipes/textures; remaining flags unresolved. No EU4 substitutes.
provenance.verification: Static full-source extraction, geometry round-trip and source conflicts checked; not engine runtime-tested.
limitations: 1820 endpoint alone supplies no transition year.
Dynamic names, political colors, startup scripts and runtime flags are not executed.
Country bounds and provinceIds are Cannor subset only, never full worldwide empire extents.
State labels and hub labels do not imply official individually named provinces.
EU4 and V3 geography is deliberately not mixed.
